data.name: Summit Half Dome in a Day
data.description: On this guided hike, you’ll conquer the heart-pounding Half Dome cables and earn breathtaking views at the summit. This is a bucket-list achievement!

meeting_point.address: Shuttle Stop 14, Curry Village, Yosemite, CA US

data.cancellation_notes:
Policy: Full payment due at booking

Cancel 30+ days → full refund minus platform & CC fees

Cancel 7–29 days → 50% refund minus fees

Cancel 0–6 days → no refund

Trips are never cancelled due to weather
data.booking_notes:
**Packing List:**
• Lunch
• Snacks & Electrolytes
• Sun Hat
• Sunglasses
• Water Bottle (3L per person, but you can start the hike with just one full)
• Sunscreen
• Bug spray
• Raincoat & Warm Layer
• Headlamp (We will start before sunrise)

**For the Half Dome Cables**
• Gloves: Any kind of work, gardening or climbing gloves to help you grip the cable.
• Boots or Trail Running Shoes: The cable climb is very steep and slippery. Your shoes must have great traction. No sneakers.

**Optional:**
• Cash, to tip your guide

*We will provide backpacks, trekking poles, water filter, & first aid kit*
data.disclaimers:
* If weather conditions such as rain, lightning, or developing storm clouds make the cables unsafe, we will not continue to the summit and will choose an alternate plan.

* This hike is an extremely strenuous physical challenge. Only those in strong physical condition who have trained should book this trip.
